observations: Grande-Allen et al., J Thorac Cardiovasc Surg. 2000;119(4 Pt 1):753-763. DOI:10.1016/S0022-5223(00)70011-0. Finite-element comparison of three aortic root replacement geometries.

entities.name: Sinus recreation and valve stress
observations: Finite-element simulations under diastolic pressure found pseudosinus geometry had the smallest leaflet stress increase (9%-28%) and strain increase (2%-31%), with coaptation closest to normal; cylindrical graft increases were greatest. This is modeling evidence, not a clinical outcome trial.
